name: Days to be Painted Like a Canvas
take: Polychrome Leap gains 120% multiplier — the mobility tool becomes a payload. Spray Paint lasts twice as long and PULLS enemies to its center every 6s, turning the mural into a vacuum. Leap and Visual Impact get interrupt immunity, and after 2s out of combat the Overflow tank auto-refills — so every fight opens with Spark Collision already loaded. The canvas primes itself.

name: Into Lights' Vanishing Point
take: +25% All DMG Amplification for herself, and the Outro learns to share: the incoming Resonator now gets an ADDITIONAL 25% All DMG Amp on top of the base dowry — 40% All DMG plus the 25% Liberation lane, all end-of-formula. This is the node that upgrades her from support to force multiplier, and it's sitting at S2 where Kuro puts the ones they want you to have. You have it. 💅

name: For One Brilliant Moment
take: The finisher node: Visual Impact and Iridescent Splash gain 90% multiplier. Then the strange, beautiful part — at full Lumiflow she banks Premixed Hue every second, up to 25 stacks, each one worth +55% Spectro DMG Bonus for Additive Color. Skate at full speed long enough and one skill-press detonates the entire savings account. The brilliance is literally pre-mixed.

name: Shadows of a Wind Racer
take: ATK +20%, flat, always on. The stat-stick node between the flashy ones — no conditions, no stacks, just a fifth of a weapon glued to her sheet for free. Even wind racers appreciate a tailwind.

name: Visions of a Future Unbound
take: Prismatic Overblast gains 70% multiplier. The team buff was always the point of the ult; this makes the ten rounds themselves worth watching. The future's unbound and so is the damage line.

name: Painted in My True Color
take: The full mural: Graffiti Blast and mid-air heavies stack Color of Soul (3 max, each +30% DMG taken from her finishers), Polychrome Leap refreshes the mid-air heavy charges to keep the loop feeding itself, she's interrupt-immune with 30% DR during them, the Outro no longer ends the Parade, the Lumiflow tank TRIPLES to 360 points — and the Intro refunds 120 Lumiflow on arrival. Every resource wall in the kit gets spray-painted over. At S6 the Parade simply does not stop.
